rationale: All 8 start runs are feasible with wide margins (hold ~+0.1 ns, 0 DRC, slew/cap far below bar), so optimise clock only. Loose targets (0.93-0.98) leave slack unused (T_eff ~6 ns). Targets near 0.5 give the best T_eff (md5 4.67, bm64 4.81) with +0.2-0.3 ns slack left, so tighten to 0.46. Both best runs used synthesis sizing, timing-driven placement, no routability spreading and post-GRT design repair. The worst tight run (des, 7.78) used DELAY 4, no sizing and no timing-driven placement. Pin md5's structure (AREA 3, cap213, post-GRT timing repair too) and let the optimizer explore utilisation, density, margins, repair percentages and ABC buffering.
